method: Manual review of every canonical record against manufacturer-published specifications. "valid" means no defect was found in this review; it is NOT live retailer or manufacturer verification and does not change any part's specsVerified flag. Lifecycle reflects availability for new builds as of the audit date and is a recommendation input, not a claim of current stock.

validity.corrected: A defect was found and repaired in this audit (see validityNote).
validity.needs-review: Record is ambiguous or uses an inconsistent convention; excluded from recommendations until resolved.
validity.invalid: Not a real purchasable product as described; excluded from recommendations, kept for identity/benchmark references.

lifecycle.previous-generation: Superseded but still sold new; eligible for recommendations.
lifecycle.legacy: Obsolete for new builds; kept for benchmarks, upgrade comparisons and saved builds, never auto-recommended.
